subject: [PATCH v2 1/2] scsi: mpt3sas: Serialize interrupt-time sdev block with hostdata teardown

2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch fixes a use-after-free bug in the mpt3sas driver by introducing a lock to serialize access to sdev hostdata during teardown. The bug occurs when the event callback runs at interrupt time and walks the sdevs, potentially freeing hostdata while still holding a reference to it. The added lock ensures that hostdata is not freed until all references are released, preventing the use-after-free issue.
